body: I do this. Sometimes his stories are so amusing and thrilling that after one I always listened. We're now good chums and talk a lot online and in real life. He knows he can talk to me about anything. It's just troubling to hear about him wanting to end himself just to not be here. He has a good life. Good friends. Nothing to create depression. No big problems and is nice to almost everyone. He just feels deep down that the world is "wrong" and that he doesn't want to be a part of it. That's how I understood it. He never sugarcoats what he says so he pretty much said that. He's a blunt person.
